# chameleon_dbt_run (Data Source)

Fetch status and logs for a dbt run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_dbt_run" "latest" {
  run_id = "9c4e1a37-7f1c-4f3a-9eba-2c8d6e3a4b50"
}

output "run_status" {
  value = data.chameleon_dbt_run.latest.status
}
```
